notes:
Snapshot: mid-market SaaS company building a customer-facing KB search + support assistant. Primary need: high-QPS hosted RAG with embeddings + reranking.

Key numbers / constraints: 
- Estimated corpus: ~2M documents (mixed: articles, tickets, transcripts). Avg doc ~1.2KB -> moderate index size (2-4B token range).
- Query profile: peak 800-1,200 QPS on weekdays (support hours), steady baseline ~150-300 QPS. Burst tolerance required.
- Latency target: P99 end-to-end <250ms; ideal 95th <120ms. Reranker budget preferred <80ms; retrieval + embedding lookup should be sub-60ms.
- Cost sensitivity: target blended cost <= $0.005 / query (includes retrieval + rerank + embeddings). VP Eng said: "If we can't get <= $0.005/q, ops will build hybrid in-house solution."
- Retrieval architecture desired: vector first-pass (approx NN) + lightweight reranker for result polishing. Interested in Redwood recommendations for batching, cache TTLs, and quantized model variants to meet cost targets.
- Embedding model: open to Redwood-curated open embed model (prefer 768-1024 dim). Want to avoid black-box proprietary costs.
- Index freshness: daily sync; occasional real-time (nearline) for urgent tickets.
- Security: SSO (SAML) mandatory, SOC2 required, audit logging and KMS for keys. Data residency for EU customers required (must ensure EU-region hosting for EU tenant subsets).

- 2026-01-05: Intro call (AE Maya) — high level requirements capture.

- Retrieval recall >= 92% on curated eval set.

- 95th latency <= 120ms at sustained 500 QPS; P99 <= 250ms at peak 1k QPS.
- Blended cost <= $0.005 per query at production mix.

- Recommendations for candidate set size (k) to balance reranker latency and quality. Carlos asked for kernel/quantization recommendations for hosted variants.
